title: The World's Nuclear Stockpile Is Growing Again After 35 Years
hook: China Added 150 Nuclear Warheads In Just 3 Years
closing: A reversed disarmament trend makes every country's security harder to predict.
question: Can the trend reverse again?

segments.say: The global nuclear stockpile fell to 12,500 warheads, proof that decades of treaties once pushed the total downward.
China's nuclear stockpile reached 500 warheads, reversing the expectation that global arsenals would keep shrinking.
Russia holds 5,580 warheads, showing established powers still dominate as China's rise changes the direction.
